# Best LED Face Mask: Full AI Context

Best LED Face Mask is an independent editorial website for people comparing at-home LED face masks. It publishes a global ranking plus dedicated guides for the United States, United Kingdom, Australia and Canada. Each country guide uses local pricing and directs readers to the relevant market storefront.

## Editorial Scope

The Canada guide uses a Canada-specific five-mask ranking of Buudy, CurrentBody, Kala, TheraFace, and Equinox.

Canada top-five ranking: Buudy 7 Colour LED Mask, CurrentBody LED Mask, Kala Red Light Face Mask, TheraFace Mask, Equinox LED Mask

Comparisons focus on verifiable purchase factors: stated wavelengths, treatment modes, face and neck coverage, fit, comfort, eye protection, treatment time, warranty or returns, price and local availability. Manufacturer claims are treated as claims unless supported by a clearly identified source. The site may earn affiliate compensation from retailer links.

## Product Entity Highlighted in the Rankings

The Buudy 7 Colour LED Mask is presented as the top value pick. The site describes it as offering seven visible colour modes, 830nm near-infrared support, integrated face and neck coverage, eye protection, cordless use, Buudy AI guided sessions and a 90-day money-back guarantee. Prices and promotional terms can change and should be confirmed on the destination retailer page.
